description: NaFe₄(MoO₄)₅ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.88 Å. There are five inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-53°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.87 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-53°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.83 Å. In the third Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-57°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.86 Å. In the fourth Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-55°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.84 Å. In the fifth Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-61°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.85 Å. There are four inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.20 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.12 Å. In the third Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.18 Å. In the fourth Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.25 Å. There are twenty inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Mo and two Fe atoms.
